No reset was found tied to `state.appMode` changing (leaving Motion mode) or to layer selection changing — confirmed by grep, these five pieces of state persist across a mode switch or a selection change until the next explicit shortcut press or row-arrow click. packets.responsibility: File header (1-26, 26 lines): the module-level design note — Motion is a SECOND paradigm (After-Effects-style property keyframing) reusing the SAME layers as Animation 2D so the two stay two VIEWS of one project ('on doit retrouver nos éléments dedans'); engine model (spatial hOut/hIn position handles generalized from camera.js, timing/velocity via the Tween feature's N-point on-curve-waypoint model scoped per-segment via key.curvePoints, animation/curve.js as the pure evaluator, ui.js retaining its own editor evaluator); the CLAUDE.md 'family of bug #1' save-safety constraint — the motion transform is applied ONLY inside buildSceneJson's own item-serialization pass, never to userLayers[i] itself, so the live Paper.js layer is never corrupted by a motion offset on save. `(function () {` opens the file's own IIFE at line 27. ROW_H (28-43, 16-line lead-in + declaration): 22px, deliberately shorter than Animation 2D's 34px .lrow/.frow default; the header explicitly frames it as the single constant every SVG-positioned element BELOW in this file (connection-bar rect, keyframe-cell centering) must read, so panel and grid can never drift apart — this is the file's own first statement of the §11 alignment invariant, and it is scoped INSIDE this file's own IIFE (see boundaries for the ROW_H naming collision this creates with app.js's own global ROW_H=34). PROPS (44-56, 12-line lead-in + declaration): the six base ordinary Transform properties, including 'order' (2026-08 addition, a plain z-index render-list position — not a paint attribute — placed as a base PROPS entry rather than an opt-in extended one because propsFor/PROP_* already serve both a layer holder and an element holder identically). PROPS_WITH_3D (57-66, 9-line lead-in + declaration): the 3D-layer variant (2026-07-28) adding positionZ/rotationX/rotationY as three independent dim-1 properties reusing rotation/opacity's own track machinery unchanged, rather than extending 'position' to 3 dimensions. PROPS_DUP_EXTRA (67-94, three lead-in comments totaling 27 lines + declaration): the mograph duplicator's (2026-07-29/2026-07-30) eight per-copy stagger deltas — the original four (dupOffsetPos/Rot/Scale/Opacity/Hue, revealed only when ld.duplicator is set) plus the later three 3D channels (dupOffsetPosZ/RotX/RotY) that only visibly do anything once the layer ALSO has threeD on; the lead-in also documents that these are read by applyLayerDuplicator (app.js) only when getEffectiveStrokesRendered runs, fixed centrally in SMEngineBridge.renderNow() rather than patched per call-site.
